function.name: get_methods_of_class
function.description: Get all method signatures defined in the specified class. Use this to understand what methods a class contains before inspecting one in detail.

function.name: get_file_functions
function.description: Get all module-level function signatures in the specified file. Use this to understand what functions a file contains.

function.name: get_file_classes
function.description: Get all class signatures in the specified file. Use this to understand what classes a file contains.

function.name: get_code_of_function
function.description: Get the source code implementation of a specific module-level function in a file.

function.name: get_code_of_class_method
function.description: Get the source code implementation of a specific method within a class.

function.name: get_callers
function.description: Get a list of functions that call the specified function. Returns callers in the format 'file:function' or 'file:Class.method'. Use this to trace how a function is used and find upstream callers.

location.description: The function location in format 'file_path:function_name' or 'file_path:ClassName.method_name'

function.name: get_callees
function.description: Get a list of functions that are called by the specified function. Returns callees in the format 'file:function' or 'file:Class.method'. Use this to trace what a function depends on and find downstream callees.

location.description: The function location in format 'file_path:function_name' or 'file_path:ClassName.method_name'

function.name: exit
function.description: Call this when you have finished exploring and are ready to return your findings.
